title: Manifold Hypothesis: Conditional Certificates and Consistent Intrinsic Dimension Estimation
summary: We study what noisy data can justify before a manifold and its intrinsic dimension are assumed. For repeated observations with independent isotropic Gaussian errors of unknown variance, we compose a support confidence event with a sound geometric verifier to certify a nearby smooth witness of arbitrary compact latent support. Whole-support inference requires an external lower mass condition; independent validation instead certifies proximity of probability mass.
